items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an immersion of algebraic stacks is unramified (author lemma at source lines 8320-8323, label lemma-immersion-unramified). The proof (source lines 8325-8335) notes that the immersion is representable hence DM, pulls it back along a smooth surjective presentation to obtain a locally closed subscheme of a scheme, applies the open and closed immersion cases for schemes, and concludes from the definition (proof lines 8326-8334). The verification of the defining clause through a presentation is the content. H2.
